slug: 2025-06-09 Home affairs to introduce electronic IDs to curb identity fraud

systems.platform: smart card with a contactless microchip holding biometric and demographic data
systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security, in collaboration with UNDP
systems.tiers: launch planned by July 2026; mobile-enabled verification and outreach teams for rural communities

note: About the electronic identity card only; nothing on civil registration.
